objectTypes.name: Effector
objectTypes.desc: Create repeated, twisted, and warped 3D object groups.

objectClasses.name: Repeater
objectClasses.description: Copies source objects by a fixed transform step.

objectClasses.name: Linear Repeater
objectClasses.description: Copies source objects evenly between the first and last transform.

objectClasses.name: Random Repeater
objectClasses.description: Copies source objects with deterministic random transforms inside ranges.

objectClasses.name: Echo Repeater
objectClasses.description: Copies source objects from explicitly evaluated earlier frames.

objectClasses.name: Twist
objectClasses.description: Bends descendant 3D meshes around the selected axis with selectable curve quality and polygon density.

objectClasses.name: Warp
objectClasses.description: Bends descendant 3D meshes with selectable curve quality, polygon density, and an optional falloff field.
